label: preparing
what: A coordinated great-hall jubilee marking my forty years as mayor, presented as an eighteen-hundred lantern inspection with builder escort. Organizers are supplying approximately 200 loaves: reportedly 152 delivered and 48 awaiting sixteen hay bales. Baker bakes, builder and innkeeper deliver and coordinate, freight seeks ingredients, and secretary coordinates reports. I now know of the jubilee, but its preparations were initially behind the inspection appointment; the full arrangements remain unconfirmed.
